title: Nextgen Networks Pty Ltd - acquisition of Silk Telecom Pty Ltd

timeline.event: Nextgen Networks Pty Ltd acquired Silk Telecom Pty Ltd.
ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Nextgen Networks Pty Ltd has acquired 100% of the shares and assets of Silk Telecom Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: For the purposes of the assessment of this acquisition only, the ACCC considered a national market for provision of transmission capacity services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the acquisition was not likely to have resulted in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant market due to the presence of a number of existing alternative suppliers for transmission capacity services within Australia.
